llm_response.reason: Sweepstakesfx.com was registered very recently with privacy protection, providing no verifiable company registration or business address. The website claims regulatory compliance but does not show specific license or regulator information. The business model requires upfront payment for an evaluation phase, offering up to 80% profit share as a proprietary trading firm—a pattern common to investment scams. Several site claims (awards, team members, psychological appeals) cannot be independently verified. These characteristics collectively indicate a likely scam.
